method.visual: All 12 pages rendered at 1.5x and inspected, including individual PNGs for baked-in text. Native text extraction is stored separately and is incomplete.
method.transcription: Visible wording, capitalization and punctuation retained. ASCII apostrophes/double quotes are used in baked-image transcription where curly shape is not decisive. Line wraps largely retained, but layout whitespace is not semantic. This is manual visual transcription, not a byte-for-byte typography encoding.
method.order: Printed page order; visual block order within page; grid position retained explicitly.
method.count_note: No assumption that the historic 91-node candidate exists or matches this inventory. Inventory block grouping is descriptive, not an approved runtime node schema.

page_inventory.reading_order_note: Skill grid is represented in visual row-major order; original locations are retained. No branching is implied.

page_inventory.source_mechanics: Three blank writing areas only. Source does not specify a save button, score, validation, character limit, account, or cloud sync.
Printed three-step in-person family instruction. No software countdown or enforcement is specified.
Physical hand gesture in an instruction, not a printed interactive screen or swipe-to-dismiss game.
External QR bonus to Hub; no implementation of the Calm/Energy wheels is specified inside the book.
One blank player-name writing line. It does not authorize identity collection, account gating, grading, or invented rewards.

findings.detail: Both visibly print the same 12 loadout rows. Page97 is the cutout front; page98 is the writable reverse; page99 is a reference duplicate. Retain distinct page provenance even when using one semantic table.
Extracted text also contains stale hidden SYSTEM: ONLINE / LVL_INDEX:96; visual pages correctly show97/99. Use visible furniture rather than hidden stale layer strings.

Full p96 reverse-UNO code is CAPTAIN, YOUR LIZARD IS DRIVING!; loadout Bonus2 short code is LIZARD IS DRIVING!. Full low-battery code is CAPTAIN IS ON 1% BATTERY.; loadout Bonus1 is CAPTAIN ON 1% BATTERY. Preserve both printed forms. No silent normalization.

World02 Levels11–20 code names align with mission names/codes known from canonical packs/extractions. World01's separate mission7–10/loadout inconsistency was resolved by the owner on 2026-09-30 in favor of mission-level codes; never mix code lists across worlds.

World01 mission7 MAKING A DEPOSIT, mission8 FERRARI MAINTENANCE, mission9 BUILDING WITH BRICKS, mission10 EATING THE FROG are approved authoritative. Conflicting printed summary variants must never replace them in the app. Decision: orchestration/brain/decisions/2026-09-30-world01-secret-code-authority.md. This is resolved and creates no new owner gate.
[ NEW PAGE: SPECIAL CODES ] is visibly printed. Preserve in source evidence; removal from release copy is an editorial choice, not an extraction fix.

Preserve exact claims and directives during extraction. Existing separate factual/child-safety review must cover no-break wording, children regulating angry parents, quiet compliance instruction, simplified lizard/wizard neuro claims, broad thought-is-spam claims, and certificate achievement framing. copy.heading: THE GLITCH:
copy.text:
TWO LIZARDS ARE IN THE SAME ROOM, YELLING. BOTH
WIZARDS ARE TOTALLY OFFLINE.

A MASSIVE FAMILY BOSS FIGHT IS STARTING.

copy.heading: THE HACK:
copy.text:
BEFORE THE GAME COMPLETELY CRASHES, YOUR FAMILY
NEEDS TO AGREE ON A COMPLETELY ABSURD SAFE WORD.

FOR EXAMPLE: "FLYING PINK BROCCOLI!"

THE MOMENT ANYONE SHOUTS IT, EVERYONE MUST
INSTANTLY INITIATE THE SYSTEM FREEZE PROTOCOL :

copy.heading: STEP 1: FREEZE.
copy.text: EVERYONE STOPS MOVING AND TALKING FOR 3 FULL SECONDS.

copy.heading: STEP 2: THE REBOOT.
copy.text:
THE PERSON WHO SHOUTED THE CODE MUST IMMEDIATELY
ASK A COMPLETELY ILLOGICAL MATH QUESTION.

EXAMPLE: "QUICK! WHAT IS 5 PLUS A BANANA?!"

copy.heading: STEP 3: ANSWER.
copy.text: EVERYONE HAS TO TRY AND ANSWER IT.

copy.heading: WHY IT WORKS (THE NEURO-MAGIC):
copy.text:
Your Lizard brain only knows how to FIGHT OR RUN.
It has ZERO SENSE OF HUMOR and is terrible at math.
When you ask an absurd, funny question,
your brain is forced to immediately
WAKE UP THE LOGICAL WIZARD to process the nonsense.
The argument LOSES ITS POWER, you usually end up laughing,
and you GET YOUR CONTROLLER BACK!

copy.heading: THE GLITCH:
copy.text:
YOU ARE TRYING TO SLEEP OR FOCUS, BUT YOUR BRAIN
KEEPS SENDING YOU SCARY "WHAT IF?" THOUGHTS.

THE ENERGY VAMPIRE IS SPAMMING YOUR SYSTEM WITH
JUNK MAIL.

copy.heading: THE HACK:
copy.text:
YOU NEED TO TREAT THAT BAD THOUGHT EXACTLY LIKE
AN ANNOYING POP-UP NOTIFICATION ON A
SMARTPHONE SCREEN.

copy.heading: STEP 1: SPOT THE SPAM.
copy.text:
CATCH THE THOUGHT AND TELL YOURSELF, "WAIT, THIS
ISN'T A FACT. THIS IS JUST A SPAM NOTIFICATION."

copy.heading: STEP 2: THE SWIPE.
copy.text:
LIFT YOUR ACTUAL HAND IN THE AIR AND PHYSICALLY
"SWIPE LEFT" TO PUSH THAT INVISIBLE POP-UP OFF YOUR
SCREEN.

copy.heading: STEP 3: DELETE.
copy.text:
SAY "DELETE" OUT LOUD (OR IN YOUR HEAD) AND
IMMEDIATELY SHIFT YOUR FOCUS BACK TO WHAT YOU WERE
DOING.

copy.heading: WHY IT WORKS (THE NEURO-MAGIC):
copy.text:
Thoughts are not facts. They are just random system alerts. When
you physically "swipe" them away, you are training your brain to
realize that YOU ARE THE CAPTAIN. You don't have to open,
read, or argue with every single pop-up message your brain sends
you. JUST SWIPE, DELETE, AND KEEP PLAYING!
